stories.title: Why AI data centers need storage beyond conventional backup power
stories.description: As AI workloads introduce sharper power fluctuations, battery storage is moving closer to computing infrastructure. EVE Energy’s AIDC portfolio illustrates how grid-scale systems, high-rate backup cabinets, and rack-level batteries address different operating demands.

stories.title: Taiwan introduces bidding framework for storage deployment at existing PV plants
stories.description: New regulations aim to encourage battery storage integration at existing solar PV plants, improve grid flexibility, and create additional revenue opportunities for renewable energy developers.

stories.title: Launch HN: StarSling (YC P25) – Self-improving CI for agent-volume repos
stories.description: We’re Yonas and Daniel and we’re building StarSling (https://starsling.dev), fast GitHub Actions runners with AI agents that ship PRs to continuously improve your tests and workflows.Every CI job gets its own ephemeral sandbox on the fastest Zen 5 machines and NVMe Disk with unlimited concurrency so a burst of agent PRs all run at once.

stories.description: "They are pretty confident that it's going to last a long, long, long time..."

stories.title: India’s Humyn Labs raises $47M to feed U.S. robotics companies the data they need
stories.description: Founded in February, Humyn Labs competes with startups including Mecka AI and XDOF, with about 90% of its revenue coming from the U.S.

stories.title: Nvidia promises that revenue will keep soaring — for now
stories.description: Despite the turmoil Nvidia is in after the departure of its disgraced founder and CEO Jensen Huang, the company projected that its streak of record-breaking revenue isn't about to stop.

stories.title: Typical energy bill forecast to go up by £443 a year from January as inflation rises again
stories.description: Energy bills are expected to jump by 26% a year for a typical household as UK inflation hits its highest rate for a year.

stories.title: Heating bills, chocolate and cat food: What the inflation figures mean for you
stories.description: Prices are rising at their fastest pace for a year in the UK, and higher energy costs are on the way.

stories.title: DiscoveryAgent: A Framework for Scientist-centric Agentic AI
stories.description: arXiv:2611.21950v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI agents can assist scientific research, but balancing autonomous investigation with scientists' ability to inspect and redirect ongoing work remains a central design challenge.

stories.title: New discovery reveals what may be holding back room-temperature superconductors
stories.description: A major breakthrough in superconductivity research has revealed that one of the essential ingredients for electricity to flow without resistance can exist at room temperature.

stories.title: France unveils bidding terms for 500 MW technology-neutral renewables tender
stories.description: France’s energy regulator has outlined the terms for a 500 MW technology-neutral renewables tender covering solar, wind and hydropower. The proposed rules introduce an unweighted reference price, raising concerns over market risks, financing costs and limited PV capacity.

stories.title: More than a billion years of Earth's history vanished. Scientists may finally know why
stories.description: Scientists may have finally explained why up to more than a billion years of Earth's geological history are missing from rocks around the world. New research suggests that powerful currents deep inside the planet slowly raised and lowered entire continents, allowing erosion to erase vast stretches of geological history before they were buried and preserved.
